parameters.query: SELECT id, name, email, timezone, focus_mode_enabled, notification_settings FROM users WHERE created_at < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' AND status = 'active' AND focus_mode_enabled = true;

SELECT
  id,
  title,
  priority,
  category,
  due_date,
  due_time,
  estimated_minutes,
  description,
  focus_score,
  CASE
    WHEN priority = 'high'   THEN 3
    WHEN priority = 'medium' THEN 2
    ELSE 1
  END AS priority_score,
  CASE
    WHEN due_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 10
    WHEN due_date = CURRENT_DATE + 1 THEN 5
    WHEN due_date IS NULL THEN 0
    ELSE GREATEST(0, 3 - (due_date - CURRENT_DATE))
  END AS urgency_score
FROM tasks
WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.id }}'
  AND status   = 'active'
  AND (due_date IS NULL OR due_date >= CURRENT_DATE)
  AND (category IN ('work', 'deep_work', 'creative') OR priority = 'high')
ORDER BY (priority_score * 2 + urgency_score) DESC, estimated_minutes ASC
LIMIT 20;

INSERT INTO user_focus_lists (user_id, focus_date, task_ids, focus_duration_minutes, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.user_id }}',
  CURRENT_DATE,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.focus_tasks.map(t => t.task_id)) }}'::jsonb,
  {{ $json.total_focus_time }},
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id, focus_date)
DO UPDATE SET
  task_ids   = EXCLUDED.task_ids,
  focus_duration_minutes = EXCLUDED.focus_duration_minutes,
  updated_at = NOW();
